Unit Test Coverage Helper v0.1.0

- Initial release providing tailored guidance for adding unit tests and increasing test coverage in existing codebases.
- Supports common workflows, checklists, and practical artifacts for software teams, QA engineers, and open-source contributors.
- Built-in validation and verification steps to ensure actionable, local-hardware-friendly outputs.
- Triggers on keywords and requests related to software testing, coverage improvement, and regression prevention.
